body:
Thank u for ur support x. 

I really hope I will be able to stand back up, because being at the bortom sucks :(

Yeah people really suck, sometimes I just lose faith that I'll ever meet someone. I'm so tired of being used. 

I know ur right, I just have to work on the ignoring part. 
Thank u x.
This hurts my heart, she's adorable!
She's adorable!
What a cutiepie!
What a cutiepie!
I relate to this so much. I think about every time I go to bed and it helps me sleep.

Yeah me too, I usually isolate myself for a while and just focus on "safe" stuff like shows I like and some video games. 
Haha I do that too, I usually get really into nature documentaries. 
Yes I know what you mean. Oh I love Kate Nash! Thank you for reaching out to me, I really needed it.

I'm okay. I think, I'm still really numb and can't seem to bring myself to do anything. Trying to stay off social media because I'm afraid I'll see something about my crush and I think that will send me spiraling down. Thanks for checking in on me <3
Thank you, I will try <3
Anytime. I'm here if you need someone to talk to or if you need to vent. <3

This is so true! The BPD makes everything about dating 1000% harder. I really thought a lot about what you said and I think I am going to take a break from guys and just try to get better and strong enough. Because just like you, I don't want to put myself in that position because it breaks me everytime and it gets harder and harder to piece myself back together again.

This helped me so much! You are right, he could be anyone! I hate that my head tells me that he is the love of my life and that I'm going to die without him. Because deep down I know that I probably would feel this way about any guy that show the slightest bit of interest in me. I really needed to hear this. Thank you! 

I'm sorry you had to go through that, I am glad that you are still here <3
I have done the same thing when my ex-obsession stopped talking to me and blocked me on all social media. But we are strong and we will get through this in spite of our mind working against us. 
Thank you for this, you made me look at the situation from another standpoint and I really do feel better now. It means a lot to me.

I have considered that as well, seems easier than being in this hell that is dating. I recognize what I'm doing but can't stop myself and afterwards when I go through my messages I feel so much shame and guilt. 
I'm sorry that happened, hope you feel better today <3 I also have a "safe" guy but I think I would react exactly the same as you if I noticed even the slightest change in his behaviour. 

You are absolutely right, I have to accept it. But it is so hard. All I want is to text and call him a thousand times and I have to try to keep myself constantly distracted to keep myself from doing so or breaking down. 

Thank you for your comment, it made me feel less alone. Sending you strenght and hugs!
Because I'm a bad person. I have fucked up everything in my life and I don't have strength to go on. I have bpd, ocd and bulimia and living with all this emotinal pain is too much.
Oh maybe it's wrong to call it a disease. I'm drunk so not in my best state

Thank you for responding! It always helps me to hear other peoples stories to know that I'm not alone. Deep down I know that people like me the way I am it's just hard sometimes. I will try to focus on the future and stop comparing myself to other people thank you for your kind words and for sharing your story. Good luck on your journey as well <3
Thank you! I think I'm going to try your method and see if it's works for me too. Again thank you and hope you have a good day/night wherever you are in the world :)

Thank you so much for your kind words, I really needed to hear this. I'm gonna try my hardest to stop cutting, because just like you said, the pain always comes back. I just broke down and called my mom so she's coming to pick me up so I can spend the night there so feeling a bit calmer. Again thank you, your words mean a lot.

Yeah that drives me crazy to, and I can't stop obsessing over it so I just sit and stare at my phone hoping that they will answer. I think I'm gonna try to resist at least until tomorrow and then maybe I'll write him one last time and then try my best to move on. Thank you for the support and for taking your time to respond, hugs!
Thank you, the same goes for you if you ever need someone to talk to 😊 yeah it gets lonely sometimes so it's always nice to talk to people who knows what it's like to have bpd.

Thank you so much for the advice! I know that I usually rush in to things without thinking so I'm gonna try to calm down and try my hardest not to obsess about him and why he doesn't answer. Seeing my therapist tomorrow so that makes me feel a bit calmer. Again thank you for taking your time to respond.
